item.title: Reed, Hillier continue fine form to share Qatar lead
item.description: Patrick Reed continued his stunning start to the season to share the first-round lead with Daniel Hillier at the Qatar Masters.

item.title: Pace on McClymont’s heels at Humewood
item.description: Scotland’s Lorna McClymont will take a two-stroke lead into Friday’s final round of the SuperSport Ladies Challenge.

item.title: Magnificent seven share Cape Town Open lead
item.description: The first-round leaderboard of the CIRCA Cape Town Open resembled the peak holiday queue for the cable car up Table Mountain. MICHAEL VLISMAS reports. Seven players finished tied for the lead on seven under par at Royal Cape Golf Club on Thursday. item.title: Gotterup leads Phoenix Open, Scheffler struggles
item.description: Chris Gotterup is off to another hot start in his bid to claim a second PGA Tour title of 2026 at the Phoenix Open.

item.title: Gooch surges into tie for lead at LIV Golf Riyadh
item.description: Talor Gooch produced another composed round to be tied for the individual lead after the second round of the LIV Golf Riyadh event.

item.title: Sattelkau edges SA’s Alexander at Humewood
item.description: Germany’s Celina Sattelkau claimed her maiden Sunshine Ladies Tour title after defeating South Africa’s Casandra Alexander in a six-hole playoff at the SuperSport Ladies Challenge.

item.title: SA’s Sterne two behind leader Reed at Qatar Open
item.description: Patrick Reed surged to the top of the Qatar Open leaderboard after day two, posting a 67 to move to 12 under par and a one-shot lead over Sweden’s Joakim Lagergren.

item.title: Cape Town Open leader Fisher Jnr hungry to win again
item.description: Trevor Fisher Jnr will take a slender lead into the weekend of the Circa Cape Town Open after carding a composed second-round 67 at Royal Cape Golf Club on Friday.

item.title: Hisatsune leads Matsuyama at Phoenix Open
item.description: Ryo Hisatsune rode a back-nine binge to an eight-under par 63 on Friday to take a one-shot lead over fellow Japanese Hideki Matsuyama at the PGA Tour's Phoenix Open.

item.title: 15-year-old wins Africa Amateur Women’s Invitational
item.description: Rising star Lisa Coetzer completed a standout week at Royal Johannesburg to win the Africa Amateur Women’s Invitational at Royal Johannesburg.
